title: Simultaneous detection of murine antigen-specific intracellular cytokines and CD107a/CD107b by flow cytometry
protocol: Sacrifice mouse and harvest spleen.
Place spleen in a 15ml polypropylene tube containing 5 ml of cRPMI.
Pour the spleen and media into a cell culture dish containing a wire mesh screen.
Prepare a single cell suspension of the splenocytes by gently pushing the spleen tissue through the wire screen with the rubber plunger end of a 5 ml syringe.
Transfer cell suspension from the culture dish into a 15 ml polypropylene tube.
Place the 15 ml tube, containing the cell suspension, upright on ice for 3-5 minutes until clumps settle to bottom.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 50 ml tube with a pipet. Leave the clumps behind.
Dilute the cell suspension to 50 ml by adding 1X PBS.
Centrifuge cells @ 400 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature. Discard supernatant.
Add 3-5 ml of 1X PharmLyse to cell pellet and mix by gently pipetting up and down.
Let cell suspension stand at room temperature for 7 minutes.
Add 10 ml of cRPMI to the cells and mix by gently pipetting up and down.
Pass cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer into a fresh 50 ml tube.
Dilute the cell suspension to 50 ml by adding 1X PBS.
Centrifuge cells @ 400 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature. Discard supernatant.
Wash with 1X PBS two more times (repeat steps diluting and centrifuging).
Resuspend cells in 5 ml of cRPMI.
Count the splenocytes and adjust the concentration to 10x10^6 cells/ml in cRPMI.
Prepare a PMA stock solution at 1 mg/ml in DMSO, aliquot, and store at -20°C.
On the day of the experiment, dilute an aliquot of PMA stock 1:1000 in PBS to make a 1 μg/ml concentration.
Prepare an ionomycin stock solution at 1 mg/ml in DMSO, aliquot, and store at -20°C.
On the day of the experiment, dilute an aliquot of frozen ionomycin stock 1:10 in PBS to make a 100 μg/ml concentration.
Prepare a sterile peptide stock solution at 2 mM in DMSO, aliquot, and store at -80°C.
On the day of the experiment, serially dilute the frozen peptide aliquot 1:1000 in cRPMI to make a 2 μM concentration.
Combine 0.1 μg CD107a-FITC with 0.5 μg CD107b-FITC in 1X PBS on the day of the experiment.
Prepare enough CD107 cocktail such that 10 μl is added to each required well.
Add Fc block to FACS wash buffer at a 1:50 ratio.
Make enough Fc block solution to add 100 μl per well (98 μl FACS wash buffer + 2 μl Fc block).
Prepare cell surface staining mAbs by diluting them in FACS wash buffer at optimal concentrations.
Mix all surface mAbs together so that the total volume added per well is 50 μl.
Prepare intracellular staining mAbs by diluting them in Perm Wash buffer at optimal concentrations.
Mix all intracellular staining mAbs together so that the total volume added per well is 50 μl.
Prepare working stock of PMA+Ionomycin activating reagent. To prepare 1 ml, add 2 μl of GolgiPlug, 2 μl of GolgiStop, 40 μl of diluted PMA, and 40 μl of diluted ionomycin to 916 μl cRPMI.
Store the PMA+Ionomycin activating reagent on ice until ready to use. Discard leftovers after activation.
Prepare working stock of unstimulated control. To prepare 1 ml, add 2 μl of GolgiPlug and 2 μl of GolgiStop to 996 μl cRPMI.
Store the unstimulated control on ice until ready to use. Discard leftovers after activation.
Prepare a working stock of peptide activating reagent.
Add 2 μl of GolgiPlug to the working stock mixture.
Add 2 μl of GolgiStop to the working stock mixture.
Add 1 μl of diluted peptide to the working stock mixture.
Mix all components with 995 μl cRPMI to prepare 1 ml of working stock.
Store the prepared working stock on ice until use.
Discard any leftovers after activation.
Dispense 100 μl of cell suspension into appropriate wells of a 96-well round-bottom plate.
Avoid cell clumps and settled cells during dispensing.
Prepare additional wells for instrument setup and compensation controls using single antibody staining.
Add 100 μl of the working stock activator to each well as required.
Add 10 μl of CD107a/CD107b-FITC cocktail to each well if needed.
Mix the contents of each well by pipetting up and down several times.
Incubate the plate for 5-6 hours at 37°C, with 7% CO2.
Optional: Store cells overnight at 4°C (not exceeding 20 hours).
Centrifuge the plate at 400 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant from the wells by quickly "flicking" the plate upside down.
Add 100 μl Fc block to each well and mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate plate on ice for 20 min.
Add 100 μl of FACS wash buffer to each well.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant by flicking the plate.
Add 50 μl of cell surface staining mAbs to the appropriate wells, mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate in the dark, on ice, for 30 min.
Add 150 μl of FACS wash buffer to each well.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant by flicking the plate.
Add 200 μl FACS wash buffer to each well, mix by pipetting up and down.
Centrifuge the plate at 400 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant by flicking the plate.
Add 100 μl Cytofix/Cytoperm to each well and mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate in the dark, on ice, for 30 min.

Optional - procedure can be interrupted at this point by freezing the cells. Wrap plate in parafilm and foil. Transfer to a -80°C freezer. To continue the procedure, thaw the plate at 37°C for ~20 min.
Add 100 μl of 1X Perm Wash Buffer to each well.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 x g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant by flicking the plate.
Add 50 μl of intracellular staining mAb to appropriate wells, mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate in the dark, on ice, for 30 min.
Add 150 μl Perm Wash buffer to each well.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant by flicking the plate.
Add 200 μl Perm Wash buffer to each well, mix by pipetting up and down.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant by flicking the plate.
Add 200 μl of FACS wash buffer to each well, mix by pipetting up and down.
Cells are ready for acquisition on an HTS plate reader or transfer samples to 12x75 ml tubes for single tube acquisition.
Acquire samples on a BD LSRII or equivalent multicolor flow cytometer.
Acquire at least 30,000 CD4+ or CD8+ T cells.
